name: timer_set
description: Sets a short in-memory timer that speaks aloud when it fires. Use for transient 'remind me to X in N minutes' tasks that must NOT go in the calendar: 'remind me to turn off the oven in 5 minutes', 'in 10 minutes tell me to check the pasta', 'set a timer for 20 minutes'. The timer lives only while Aegon is running and is never saved. NOT for appointments or dated events — those use reminder_set.

message.description: What Sir wants to be reminded of when the timer fires.

when.description: Short relative fuse: 'in 5 minutes', '20 minutes', 'in half an hour'.
